```python
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
```

```python
def trap_rain(height):
    if not height:
        return 0
    
    left, right = 0, len(height) - 1
    left_max, right_max = height[left], height[right]
    total = 0
    
    while left < right:
        if left_max < right_max:
            left += 1
            left_max = max(left_max, height[left])
            total += left_max - height[left]
        else:
            right -= 1
            right_max = max(right_max, height[right])
            total += right_max - height[right]
    
    return total
```

```python
from flask import Flask
from flask_restful import Api, Resource
import requests
import time

def create_app(template_folder='templates', api_url='http://default-api-url'):
    app = Flask(__name__, template_folder=template_folder)
    api = Api(app)

    class DataResource(Resource):
        _cache = None
        _last_fetched = None
        CACHE_TTL = 300  # Cache time-to-live in seconds

        def get(self):
            if DataResource._cache is not None and time.time() - DataResource._last_fetched < self.CACHE_TTL:
                return DataResource._cache
            
            response = requests.get(api_url)
            data = response.json()
            DataResource._cache = data
            DataResource._last_fetched = time.time()
            return data

    api.add_resource(DataResource, '/data')

    return app
```
